questions.q: How many keys are on a standard piano?
questions.note: 52 white, 36 black.

questions.q: How many cards are in a UNO deck?
questions.note: Including the four wild draw-fours everyone claims never to have.

questions.q: How many tiles are in an English Scrabble set?
questions.note: Two of them are blanks.

questions.q: How many squares are on a Monopoly board?
questions.note: Ten of them you would rather not land on.

questions.q: How many dots are there in total on a pair of dice?
questions.note: 21 per die — every face from 1 to 6.

questions.q: How many episodes of Friends were made?
questions.note: Ten seasons, 1994 to 2004.

questions.q: How many Oscars did Titanic win?
questions.note: Tied with Ben-Hur and The Return of the King.

questions.q: How many official James Bond films were released from Dr. No to No Time to Die?
questions.note: Six actors have worn the tux.

questions.q: How tall is the Burj Khalifa?
questions.note: It has held the world record since 2010.

questions.q: How many floors does the Burj Khalifa have?
questions.note: Its lifts travel at about 10 metres a second.

questions.q: How many rooms are there in Buckingham Palace?
questions.note: 78 of them are bathrooms.

questions.q: How many stations does the London Underground have?
questions.note: The network opened in 1863 — the world's first.

questions.q: How long is the Trans-Siberian Railway?
questions.note: Seven days end to end, across eight time zones.

questions.q: How many steps are there to the summit of the Eiffel Tower?
questions.note: Most people take the lift. Wisely.

questions.q: How tall is the Eiffel Tower to the tip?
questions.note: It grows about 15cm on a hot day as the iron expands.

questions.q: How many ridges are on the edge of a US quarter?
questions.note: Originally there to stop people shaving silver off the rim.

questions.q: How many dimples are on a typical golf ball?
questions.note: They cut drag and roughly double how far the ball flies.

questions.q: How many calories are in a Big Mac?
questions.note: The bun alone is about 130.

questions.q: How many grapes does it take to make one bottle of wine?
questions.note: Roughly 1.2kg of fruit.

questions.q: How many member states does the United Nations have?
questions.note: The newest is South Sudan, which joined in 2011.

questions.q: How many countries are there in Africa?
questions.note: More than a quarter of all UN members.

questions.q: How many time zones does Russia span?
questions.note: From Kaliningrad to Kamchatka.

questions.q: How many islands does Indonesia officially have?
questions.note: About 6,000 of them are inhabited.

questions.q: How many islands does the Philippines have?
questions.note: The official count went up by 500 after a 2016 survey.

questions.q: How many elements are on the periodic table?
questions.note: The four most recent were officially named in 2016.

questions.q: How many current words are defined in the Oxford English Dictionary?
questions.note: Plus about 47,000 that have fallen out of use.

questions.q: How many words is Shakespeare credited with coining?
questions.note: Including 'eyeball', 'lonely' and 'swagger'.

questions.q: How many runs did Sachin Tendulkar score in Test cricket?
questions.note: Still the most by any player in history.

questions.q: How many international centuries did Sachin Tendulkar score?
questions.note: Tests and one-dayers combined. Nobody else has reached it.

questions.q: How many Olympic gold medals did Michael Phelps win?
questions.note: Across four Games — more than most countries.

questions.q: How many Grand Slam singles titles has Serena Williams won?
questions.note: One short of Margaret Court's all-time record.

questions.q: How tall is the Statue of Unity in Gujarat?
questions.note: The tallest statue in the world — nearly twice the Statue of Liberty.

questions.q: How many steps lead from the base of the Statue of Liberty to the crown?
questions.note: Equivalent to climbing a 20-storey building.

questions.q: How many years did it take to build the Taj Mahal?
questions.note: Finished around 1653.

questions.q: How many workers built the Taj Mahal?
questions.note: Plus around 1,000 elephants to haul the marble.

questions.q: How many possible positions does a Rubik's Cube have, in quintillions?
questions.note: And every single one can be solved in 20 moves or fewer.

questions.q: How many steps are there in the Spanish Steps in Rome?
questions.note: Sitting on them has been a finable offence since 2019.

questions.q: How many bricks were used to build the Empire State Building, in millions?
questions.note: The whole thing went up in 410 days.

questions.q: How many stations does the New York City subway have?
questions.note: More than any other metro system on Earth.

questions.q: How many pieces are in a standard chess set?
questions.note: Sixteen a side, six kinds, and roughly 10^120 possible games.

questions.q: How fast does light travel, in kilometres per second?
questions.note: Nothing with mass will ever get there.

questions.q: How far away is the Moon, on average?
questions.note: Light makes the trip in 1.3 seconds.

questions.q: What is the diameter of the Earth at the equator?
questions.note: It's slightly squashed — the pole-to-pole diameter is 43km less.

questions.q: What is the circumference of the Earth at the equator?
questions.note: Eratosthenes worked it out to within a few percent in 240 BC.

questions.q: How tall is Mount Everest?
questions.note: Re-measured in 2020 — and it had grown by 86cm.

questions.q: How deep is the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench?
questions.note: Drop Everest in and its peak would still be 2km underwater.

questions.q: What is the surface temperature of the Sun, in Celsius?
questions.note: The core is about 2,700 times hotter than that.

questions.q: How hot is the Sun's core, in millions of degrees Celsius?
questions.note: Hot enough to fuse hydrogen into helium.

questions.q: How many Earths would fit inside the Sun?
questions.note: And the Sun is an entirely unremarkable star.

questions.q: How many confirmed moons does Jupiter have?
questions.note: As of 2024 — astronomers keep finding more.

questions.q: How long is the Amazon River?
questions.note: It carries about a fifth of all the river water on Earth.

questions.q: How long is the Nile?
questions.note: Long enough to argue with the Amazon about which is longest.

questions.q: How many countries does the Nile flow through?
questions.note: It starts a very long way south of Egypt.

questions.q: How old is the Earth, in millions of years?
questions.note: Dated from meteorites, because Earth recycles its own rocks.

questions.q: How many stars are in the Milky Way, in billions?
questions.note: And there are around two trillion galaxies.

questions.q: How many minutes does sunlight take to reach Earth?
questions.note: You always see the Sun slightly in the past.

questions.q: How many days does the Moon take to orbit the Earth?
questions.note: 27.3, to be precise.

questions.q: How fast does Earth travel around the Sun, in km/h?
questions.note: You're doing it right now and can't feel a thing.

questions.q: How many volcanoes on Earth are considered active?
questions.note: About 50 of them erupt in any given year.

questions.q: How many times does lightning strike the Earth every second?
questions.note: Roughly 8 million a day.

questions.q: What percentage of the Earth's water is fresh water?
questions.note: And most of that is locked up in ice.

questions.q: How tall is Angel Falls, the world's highest waterfall?
questions.note: In the dry season much of the water evaporates before it lands.

questions.q: How deep is Lake Baikal, the deepest lake on Earth?
questions.note: It holds a fifth of the world's unfrozen fresh water.

questions.q: How big is the Sahara Desert, in millions of square kilometres?
questions.note: About the size of the United States.

questions.q: How many countries does Brazil share a border with?
questions.note: Everyone in South America except Chile and Ecuador.

questions.q: How many countries does China share a border with?
questions.note: Tied with Russia for the most in the world.

questions.q: How long is the border between Canada and the USA?
questions.note: The longest land border between any two countries.

questions.q: How many cubic metres of water go over Niagara Falls every second?
questions.note: Enough to fill an Olympic pool about every second.

questions.q: How high does the International Space Station orbit?
questions.note: Closer than London is to Edinburgh — just straight up.

questions.q: How many minutes does the ISS take to orbit the Earth once?
questions.note: Sixteen sunrises a day for the crew.

questions.q: How far is the Earth from the Sun, in millions of kilometres?
questions.note: Defined as one astronomical unit.

questions.q: What is the diameter of the Moon?
questions.note: About a quarter of Earth's — unusually large for a moon.

questions.q: How many named storms are there in an average Atlantic hurricane season?
questions.note: The official average was revised upwards in 2021.

questions.q: How many stars can the naked eye see across the whole sky on a perfect night?
questions.note: Under city lights, closer to twenty.

questions.q: How old is the universe, in millions of years?
questions.note: The first stars lit up about 200 million years in.

questions.q: How many constellations do astronomers officially recognise?
questions.note: Fixed by international agreement in 1922.

questions.q: How long is the Great Barrier Reef?
questions.note: The largest living structure on Earth, visible from orbit.

questions.q: What is the highest air temperature ever recorded on Earth, in Celsius?
questions.note: Death Valley, California, 1913.

questions.q: How many degrees below zero was the coldest natural temperature ever recorded on Earth?
questions.note: Vostok Station, Antarctica, 1983.

questions.q: How long is Canada's coastline, the longest in the world?
questions.note: About a tenth of all the coastline on the planet.

packs.name: Body & Beasts
packs.tagline: You, animals, and the machinery of life

questions.q: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.note: You started with far more — many fused as you grew.

questions.q: How many bones is a baby born with?
questions.note: Around 64 of them fuse together by adulthood.

questions.q: How many teeth are in a full adult human set?
questions.note: Including the four wisdom teeth most people have removed.

questions.q: How many vertebrae are in the human spine?
questions.note: Nine of them fuse into the sacrum and tailbone.

questions.q: How many bones are in one human hand?
questions.note: More than a quarter of your skeleton is in your hands and feet.

questions.q: Roughly how many muscles are in the human body?
questions.note: Anatomists still argue about the exact count.

questions.q: How many litres of blood does an average adult have?
questions.note: Your heart moves all of it around roughly once a minute.

questions.q: How many times does the average heart beat in a day?
questions.note: About 2.5 billion over a lifetime.

questions.q: How many breaths does the average person take in a day?
questions.note: You noticed exactly one of them just now.

questions.q: How many hairs are on an average human head?
questions.note: You shed about a hundred a day.

questions.q: How many kilometres of blood vessels are in an adult body?
questions.note: Enough to wrap around the Earth twice.

questions.q: How long is the human digestive tract?
questions.note: Coiled into a space about the size of a football.

questions.q: How many cells are in the human body, in trillions?
questions.note: Plus roughly the same number of bacteria along for the ride.

questions.q: How many sweat glands does the human body have, in millions?
questions.note: The highest density is on your palms and the soles of your feet.

questions.q: How many days does a red blood cell live?
questions.note: You make about two million new ones every second.

questions.q: How many bones are in a giraffe's neck?
questions.note: Exactly the same number as in yours — just much bigger.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.note: Two pump the gills, one pumps the rest of the body.

questions.q: How many eyes does a bee have?
questions.note: Two big compound eyes and three simple ones on top of its head.

questions.q: How many legs does a lobster have?
questions.note: Counting the two that carry the claws.

questions.q: What is the top speed of a cheetah, in km/h?
questions.note: It can only hold it for about 30 seconds before overheating.

questions.q: How fast is a peregrine falcon in a dive, in km/h?
questions.note: The fastest animal on the planet, by a wide margin.

questions.q: How many times a minute does a hummingbird's heart beat in flight?
questions.note: Yours is about 70.

questions.q: How much does a blue whale's tongue weigh, in kilograms?
questions.note: About the weight of a small elephant.

questions.q: How much does an adult blue whale's heart weigh, in kilograms?
questions.note: Roughly the size of a golf cart.

questions.q: How long is an adult blue whale?
questions.note: The largest animal that has ever existed, dinosaurs included.

questions.q: How many ants are alive on Earth, in quadrillions?
questions.note: About 2.5 million ants for every human being.

questions.q: How many species of beetle have been described by science?
questions.note: About a quarter of every known animal species is a beetle.

questions.q: How old is the oldest known living tree, in years?
questions.note: A bristlecone pine in California, older than the pyramids.

questions.q: How tall is the tallest tree on Earth?
questions.note: A coast redwood named Hyperion — its location is kept secret.

questions.q: How many species of bird are there?
questions.note: And the count keeps rising as DNA splits look-alikes apart.

questions.q: How many known species of shark are there?
questions.note: Only a handful are any threat to people.

questions.q: How many eggs can a queen termite lay in a day?
questions.note: Every day, for up to 25 years.

questions.q: How many times per second does a housefly beat its wings?
questions.note: That buzz is the wings, not a voice.

questions.q: How many times a day does a woodpecker peck?
questions.note: Its skull is built like a shock absorber.

questions.q: What percentage of human DNA is shared with a chimpanzee?
questions.note: The other 2% is where every difference lives.

questions.q: How many litres of saliva does a person produce in a year?
questions.note: Roughly two bathtubs' worth.

questions.q: How many times does a person blink in a day?
questions.note: About 15 a minute while you're awake.

questions.q: How many bones are in one human foot?
questions.note: A quarter of your skeleton sits below your ankles.

questions.q: How many litres of air does a person breathe in a day?
questions.note: Most of it nitrogen you never use.

questions.q: How many muscles does an elephant's trunk contain?
questions.note: Enough control to pick up a single peanut.
